description: For drywall repair, this completion sign-off form records cutout boundary, backing, board type, treatment, drying intervals, dust control, texture match, and painting handoff. Its supporting evidence includes moisture check, cavity photo, repair-stage photos, material record, surface flatness, and finish comparison.
